_comment: Findings the maintainer has ruled on. Each one is a defect in the PRINTED book, not in the parse, so the record keeps what the page says and the ruling is applied where the corpus is built - curated-readings.json, read by build_entry_xml.readings(). They are counted separately from the worklist so a page the maintainer has already answered stops coming back. `maintainer` quotes the ruling as it was written.

rulings.maintainer: That's effectively two words: "ka-p-acay-en a ayuzi" is "widow" and "ka-p-acay-an a binanau'az" is "widower".
rulings.handled: curated-readings.json: two readings, one English each

rulings.maintainer: There is a typographical error in the book. Interpret #3 as: The definition of "filhaq a rima" and "rima a filhaq" are both "finger". Interpret #4 as: The definition of "filhaq a kuskus" and "kuskus a filhaq" is "toe". This was just a failure to change fonts. It's also a failure to note that these are two different headwords (really head phrases) with the words in a different order.
rulings.handled: curated-readings.json: two readings sharing one English, for each of senses 3 and 4
